messages:
Alice R: FYI: Nvidia published a driver vulnerability (CVE-2026-10101) affecting 535.* and older driver packages. Need triage for Dedicated + Private fleets. Can we get impacted image list and a patch plan?
Ben K: On it. Quick q — which fleets have drivers baked into AMIs vs host-installed via apt/rpm? I'll scan inventory and image tags.
Carla M: Also point: confirm driver packages are KMS-signed and that install events are captured in our audit logs. If not, we need compensating controls for the interim.
DevSecBot: Vulnerability detected: CVE-2026-10101 | severity: HIGH | affected: nvidia-driver-535, nvidia-container-runtime | ticket: SEC-2026-2337 | see infra/vuln-feed/2026-03
InfraOncall: Quick snapshot from inventory: Dedicated eu-west1 + private-onprem-1 show 535.54 as active driver. Hosted API nodes are on 540.x and appear unaffected. Canary candidates: gpu-pool-eu-a100.
Simon L: Proposed immediate plan:
1) Canary tonight on a single hostpool in eu-west1 (gpu-A100-40G).
2) Run model-regression + perf suite + driver smoke tests (nvml/nvprof).
3) If green, batch roll Dedicated over next 3 days.
Fallback: apt/dpkg rollback + reboot to previous kernel/driver snapshot. I'll add automated health-checks and alert hooks.
Maya P: Heads-up — some INT8 quantized kernels in our runtime depend on cuDNN microversions. We must validate cuDNN and NCCL compatibility after driver bump. I'll queue the q8-regression after canary.
Ben K: Quick check command I use in images/containers: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv && nvcc --version || cat /usr/local/cuda/version.txt` — will run across AMIs and post results.
Carla M: KMS note: we currently sign packages with internal key kmk-prod-01. For Private customers with their own HSM, confirm whether they require package re-signing or a signed manifest. Opening SR with support for those tenants.
DevSecBot: Action item: enable audit event `package.install` for hosts in affected pools and increase retention to 90 days. Policy PR: infra/audit#142.
Alice R: Prioritization: Dedicated > Private (customer compliance) > Hosted. Tentative timeline: canary tonight, batch roll next 3 days, coordinate private customer windows within 7–14 days.
InfraOncall: Note: some AMIs may need kernel-module rebuilds for certain kernels (>=5.15). Snapshots and AMI bake steps ready; expect ~15–30m per AMI.
Simon L: I'll produce a compatibility matrix (GPU type, driver, CUDA, cuDNN, NCCL). Ben — can you grep images for cuDNN package versions and list container images that pin CUDA?
Ben K: On it. ETA ~2h. Posting results here when done.
Maya P: I'll queue 50 inference jobs across p3/p4 sims after canary and watch latency and token regen errors.
Carla M: Action items summary (adding to SEC-2026-2337):
- Ben: image + container scan, artifact list, driver/cuda versions
- Simon: canary orchestration, health-checks, rollback playbook
- Maya: regression + perf suite runs post-canary
- Carla: KMS signing audit & private-customer SR
- Alice: comms + customer notifications
I'll update ticket with owners and deadlines.
Alice R: :thumbsup: Keep updates short in this thread. If perf regressions surface, hold rollout and escalate to Nvidia rep.
DevSecBot: SEC ticket updated: SEC-2026-2337 | status=investigating | priority=high | sla=48h
Ben K: Posting preliminary image scan (short): 12 AMIs with 535.*, 3 container images with bundled 535.54; detailed list in SEC-2026-2337/attachments.
Simon L: Canary scheduled 23:00 UTC. Health-checks: driver load, nvml init, gRPC inference smoke, NCCL ring test. Will post results here.
Maya P: queued jobs for canary. will post perf + correctness matrix after run.
Carla M: Audit & KMS update: package.install audit enabled for canary hosts; KMS signing intact for our artifacts, private tenants may need re-sign — SR created.
InfraOncall: Canary finished: driver installed, modules rebuilt, basic nvml/nvprof pass. Minor warning: one custom AMI needed DKMS rebuild. No crash observed.
Simon L: Canary health: PASS on functional + perf baseline within 3% of previous. Rolling to next batch in 6h.
Alice R: Great work — keep ticket updated and prep customer comms for those private tenants.
DevSecBot: Ticket SEC-2026-2337 | status=patching | note=rolling to Dedicated batches
